title: Mark Tilbury Economics: U.S. Debt and Mortgage Rates: Tilbury's Bond-Market Warning
description:
Original video author: Mark Tilbury Economics. Independent recap and commentary; no endorsement implied. Mark Tilbury Economics connects U.S. debt and mortgage rates through rising Treasury borrowing costs. This recap covers the channel's August 2026 claims of $40 trillion in debt and more than $1 trillion in annual interest, then its explanation of retreating long-term bond buyers. We unpack its term-premium argument, higher-yield opportunities and bond-price risks before reviewing its account of unsuccessful Treasury buybacks and a $22 billion 30-year auction at 5.3%.

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.

#MarkTilburyEconomics #TheFirstDominointheUSDebtCrisis #USdebtandmortgagerates #Housing #RealEstate
